text: 当前共有 22 个活跃事件。要点包括: China-modified Nvidia RTX 5090 with massive 96GB of memory appears on Alibaba for less than $4,000 — 3x more VRAM at 65% the cost of the original; OpenAI Is Considering Slowing Down The Development Of Cutting-edge AI, Sam Altman Is Hoping Other AI Companies Will Do The Same; GPT-6 Astra does 3D camera tracking and VFX in Blender; The GSA says OpenAI is replacing its $1-per-year pilot for US agencies with a usage-based deal at a 50% discount from October 1, including access to GPT-6 Astra (Maggie Eastland/Bloomberg); 啊？Anthropic最高320万招销售，只为服务Meta。

【新兴趋势】

AI算力主线出现三条新动向。一是企业级AI capex向下一代GPU锚定：LG CNS明确披露3814亿韩元采购英伟达Vera Rubin，这是韩国大客户对Rubin世代的首次公开背书，配合高通-AWS 600亿美元定制芯片协议，标志通用GPU与定制ASIC并行放量，而非替代关系。二是Agent基础设施进入"水电化"阶段：OpenAI将支撑Codex/ChatGPT的Agent栈以公开API形式对外开放，联合Cloudflare、Vercel、Oracle提供沙箱；阿里云同日升级Token Plan并按MCP标准接入12类Agent Harness。Agent层不再是单家模型公司的内部能力，而是跨云、跨工具的公共底座，token消耗与推理算力需求将出现非线性放大。
